'''Jason Baucom''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[August 2001 Raleigh tournament]] on 18 August 2001 with [[My Lord, Is That Legal? / I Will Make It Legal|Senate objective with Maul's site]], according to Mike Merletto's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2860">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-19-raleigh-nc-8-18-01-absolute-moneyd2860/ raleigh-nc-8-18-01-absolute-money], DeckTech (Mike "OQrygg" Merletto, 19 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-19-raleigh-nc-8-18-01-absolute-moneyd2860/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
